sources.fact: Completion of assigned work precedes participant-selected progression; initial load was supervised.
General healthy-adult synthesis supports individualized progressive training; it does not define one executable SBD programme.
sources.limit: Group evidence; exact app workflow and individual first-load choice not evaluated.

sources.fact: Earlier position stand describes 2–10% increases after exceeding target repetitions.
sources.decision: Do not import this range into a fixed-five-repetition prototype as a universal or newer recommendation.

decisions.scope: Adult independently performing SBD and already able to select a working load.
decisions.implemented: initial_loads_kg is required per session; no 1RM test or inferred percentage.
decisions.remaining_gap: User who cannot select any first load requires guided instruction/assessment; that flow is not implemented.

eligibility: Most recent session for this lift is completed
All prescribed repetitions and loads completed without set load changes
Single actual working load across the lift's sets
No pain report in the referenced workout
decisions.implementation: User submits chosen load and reference workout/event hash. Server checks meaning, persistence and retry consistency.
decisions.increment_rule: Positive user-selected change representable by configured equipment step; no recommended magnitude.
decisions.limit: Matching a completed record does not establish current readiness, correct technique, appropriate increment or training effectiveness.

decisions.implementation: No completion-based repeat/increase claim; previous set-level actuals remain available. Manual input remains supported.

decisions.reason: One successful set does not meet the reported all-assigned-work condition.

decisions.implementation: Pain context removes completion-based choice types; no automatic reduction. Elapsed time remains visible through next-session.
decisions.remaining_gap: Current pain assessment and long-gap applicability remain unimplemented; user choice is not approval.

adversarial_review: Do not call selected increment scientifically optimal or safe.
Manual entry may still be changed by the user; choice validation is provenance integrity, not a clinical restriction.
Maintain frozen selected load and reference identity when later records change.
Check stale references again within the write transaction.
Retain internal-preview access until programme applicability and deployment are separately resolved.
next_blocker: Review applicability of the complete SBD-only weekly programme for public supply; the original OHP omission changes dose. Resolve unknown first-load pathway separately from known-working-load users.
